overview.zh: S3SensorCanProtocol.h 定义 S3→P4 encoder 分片与 CRC、逐通道错误码、触觉摘要、raw diagnostics 和 full dump 的 CAN ID 与分片规则。P4 收到完整帧组并通过长度/序号/CRC/超时检查后才发布有效快照。
overview.en: S3SensorCanProtocol.h defines S3→P4 CAN IDs and fragmentation for encoder data/CRC, per-channel errors, tactile summaries, raw diagnostics, and full dumps. P4 publishes a valid snapshot only after complete reception and length/sequence/CRC/deadline checks.

zh.plain: CAN 总览把 S3→P4 编码器、错误细节、触觉摘要、诊断和全量触觉数据分配到不同 CAN ID 区间。
zh.condition: 该节点汇总 S3SensorCanProtocol.h 中共同定义的 ID、帧大小与校验时限。
zh.effect: 接收端按 ID 选择解析器，再校验 DLC、片段、序号、CRC 与重组时限后更新快照。
zh.failure: 缺帧、错长、CRC 错或超时会使本轮样本无效；应检查对应通信规则。
zh.recovery: 核对 S3 与 P4 的共享定义和部署固件版本。
zh.unknown: 源码是静态协议定义，不能证明当前总线帧已到达、数据新鲜或传感器物理读数正确。
zh.difference: 此节点说明 can 的编码/范围角色；其它 CAN 消息使用各自的 ID 区间和组包条件。
zh.change: 基线未标记该 ID/协议定义为本次变更。

en.plain: The map assigns separate CAN ID ranges to S3→P4 encoders, error details, tactile summary, diagnostics, and full tactile data.
en.condition: This node summarizes shared IDs, frame sizes, and validation deadlines in S3SensorCanProtocol.h.
en.effect: The receiver selects a parser by ID and validates DLC, fragments, sequence, CRC, and deadline before updating a snapshot.
en.failure: Missing frames, wrong length, CRC errors, or timeout invalidate a sample; inspect the related communication rule.
en.recovery: Check shared definitions and deployed firmware versions on S3 and P4.
en.unknown: These are static protocol definitions; they do not prove a live frame arrived, data is fresh, or a physical sensor reading is correct.
en.difference: This node describes the encoding/range role of can; other CAN messages have separate ID ranges and reassembly rules.
en.change: The baseline does not mark this ID/protocol definition as changed.

zh.plain: 编码器 raw-angle 帧从 0x100 开始；一个 8 字节帧装最多 4 个 16-bit 原始值。
zh.condition: 源码常量/表达式：`0x100`。它定义该消息类别的 ID 值或区间。
zh.effect: P4 用 CAN ID 减去 base 得到数据片段编号，并放入编码器重组缓存。
zh.failure: DLC 不为 8 时报告 CAN frame invalid 并标坏本轮快照。
zh.recovery: 核对发送端 ID 起点、DLC 和每帧通道布局。
zh.unknown: 源码是静态协议定义，不能证明当前总线帧已到达、数据新鲜或传感器物理读数正确。
zh.difference: 此节点说明 CAN_ID_ENC_BASE 的编码/范围角色；其它 CAN 消息使用各自的 ID 区间和组包条件。
zh.change: 基线未标记该 ID/协议定义为本次变更。

en.plain: Encoder raw-angle frames start at 0x100; one 8-byte frame carries up to four 16-bit raw values.
en.condition: Source constant/expression: `0x100`. It defines the ID or range for this message class.
en.effect: P4 subtracts this base ID to obtain a fragment index and stores values in the encoder reassembly buffer.
en.failure: A DLC other than 8 reports an invalid CAN frame and marks this snapshot bad.
en.recovery: Check sender base ID, DLC, and per-frame channel layout.
en.unknown: These are static protocol definitions; they do not prove a live frame arrived, data is fresh, or a physical sensor reading is correct.
en.difference: This node describes the encoding/range role of CAN_ID_ENC_BASE; other CAN messages have separate ID ranges and reassembly rules.
en.change: The baseline does not mark this ID/protocol definition as changed.

zh.plain: 按 21 路编码器、每帧 4 路向上取整，数据 ID 范围最后一帧由该表达式计算。
zh.condition: 源码常量/表达式：`CAN_ID_ENC_BASE + (ENCODER_TOTAL_NUM + 3) / 4 - 1`。它定义该消息类别的 ID 值或区间。
zh.effect: 表达式 `CAN_ID_ENC_BASE + (ENCODER_TOTAL_NUM + 3) / 4 - 1` 给出最后一个 raw-angle 分片。
zh.failure: 缺少任何分片时，即使 CRC 帧到了也不能得到完整快照。
zh.recovery: 修改通道数后同步核对 frame count、payload bytes 与 CAN ID 范围。
zh.unknown: 源码是静态协议定义，不能证明当前总线帧已到达、数据新鲜或传感器物理读数正确。
zh.difference: 此节点说明 CAN_ID_ENC_LAST 的编码/范围角色；其它 CAN 消息使用各自的 ID 区间和组包条件。
zh.change: 基线未标记该 ID/协议定义为本次变更。

en.plain: For 21 encoders with four values per frame, the expression rounds up to derive the final data-frame ID.
en.condition: Source constant/expression: `CAN_ID_ENC_BASE + (ENCODER_TOTAL_NUM + 3) / 4 - 1`. It defines the ID or range for this message class.
en.effect: The expression `CAN_ID_ENC_BASE + (ENCODER_TOTAL_NUM + 3) / 4 - 1` gives the final raw-angle fragment.
en.failure: If any fragment is missing, a later CRC frame cannot complete the snapshot.
en.recovery: When channel count changes, check frame count, payload bytes, and CAN ID range together.
en.unknown: These are static protocol definitions; they do not prove a live frame arrived, data is fresh, or a physical sensor reading is correct.
en.difference: This node describes the encoding/range role of CAN_ID_ENC_LAST; other CAN messages have separate ID ranges and reassembly rules.
en.change: The baseline does not mark this ID/protocol definition as changed.

zh.plain: 最后一个编码器分片之后的专用 ID 承载整批角度数据的 CRC 与元数据。
zh.condition: 源码常量/表达式：`CAN_ID_ENC_LAST + 1`。它定义该消息类别的 ID 值或区间。
zh.effect: 接收端核对片段完整性、数量/字节数及 CRC16 后才更新有效 encoder snapshot。
zh.failure: CRC 或元数据不匹配会报告 snapshot invalid 并重置当前重组。
zh.recovery: 对照 S3/P4 的 CRC 输入字节顺序和帧数。
zh.unknown: 源码是静态协议定义，不能证明当前总线帧已到达、数据新鲜或传感器物理读数正确。
zh.difference: 此节点说明 CAN_ID_ENC_CRC 的编码/范围角色；其它 CAN 消息使用各自的 ID 区间和组包条件。
zh.change: 基线未标记该 ID/协议定义为本次变更。

en.plain: The dedicated ID after the last encoder fragment carries CRC and metadata for the complete angle batch.
en.condition: Source constant/expression: `CAN_ID_ENC_LAST + 1`. It defines the ID or range for this message class.
en.effect: The receiver updates a valid encoder snapshot only after checking completeness, count/byte length, and CRC16.
en.failure: CRC or metadata mismatch reports an invalid snapshot and resets reassembly.
en.recovery: Compare CRC input byte order and frame count on S3 and P4.
en.unknown: These are static protocol definitions; they do not prove a live frame arrived, data is fresh, or a physical sensor reading is correct.
en.difference: This node describes the encoding/range role of CAN_ID_ENC_CRC; other CAN messages have separate ID ranges and reassembly rules.
en.change: The baseline does not mark this ID/protocol definition as changed.

zh.plain: 0x1F0 起的三帧错误表覆盖 21 路通道，每帧至多七个错误码。
zh.condition: 源码常量/表达式：`0x1F0`。它定义该消息类别的 ID 值或区间。
zh.effect: P4 按 sequence 重组每路 errorFlags；这些标志参与对应角度值有效性判断。
zh.failure: 缺帧或超过 100 ms 的组装时限会使错误表无法完整更新。
zh.recovery: 检查三帧序号、DLC 和 error detail timeout。
zh.unknown: 源码是静态协议定义，不能证明当前总线帧已到达、数据新鲜或传感器物理读数正确。
zh.difference: 此节点说明 CAN_ID_ERROR_DETAIL_BASE 的编码/范围角色；其它 CAN 消息使用各自的 ID 区间和组包条件。
zh.change: 基线未标记该 ID/协议定义为本次变更。

en.plain: The three-frame error table from 0x1F0 covers 21 channels with up to seven error codes per frame.
en.condition: Source constant/expression: `0x1F0`. It defines the ID or range for this message class.
en.effect: P4 reassembles per-channel errorFlags by sequence; these flags contribute to angle-value validity.
en.failure: Missing frames or the 100 ms reassembly deadline can prevent a complete error-table update.
en.recovery: Check the three frame sequences, DLC, and error-detail timeout.
en.unknown: These are static protocol definitions; they do not prove a live frame arrived, data is fresh, or a physical sensor reading is correct.
en.difference: This node describes the encoding/range role of CAN_ID_ERROR_DETAIL_BASE; other CAN messages have separate ID ranges and reassembly rules.
en.change: The baseline does not mark this ID/protocol definition as changed.

zh.plain: 0x1F2 是从 0x1F0 开始的三帧 encoder 错误表末 ID。
zh.condition: 源码常量/表达式：`0x1F2`。它定义该消息类别的 ID 值或区间。
zh.effect: base 到 last 界定错误码分片；frame count 和端点必须一致。
zh.failure: 错序、越界或缺片都会让该轮错误表不完整。
zh.unknown: 源码是静态协议定义，不能证明当前总线帧已到达、数据新鲜或传感器物理读数正确。
zh.difference: 此节点说明 CAN_ID_ERROR_DETAIL_LAST 的编码/范围角色；其它 CAN 消息使用各自的 ID 区间和组包条件。
zh.change: 基线未标记该 ID/协议定义为本次变更。

en.plain: 0x1F2 is the final ID of the three-frame encoder error table starting at 0x1F0.
en.condition: Source constant/expression: `0x1F2`. It defines the ID or range for this message class.
en.effect: The base-to-last range bounds error-code fragments; frame count and endpoint must agree.
en.failure: Sequence mismatch, out-of-range IDs, or missing fragments leave this error table incomplete.
en.unknown: These are static protocol definitions; they do not prove a live frame arrived, data is fresh, or a physical sensor reading is correct.
en.difference: This node describes the encoding/range role of CAN_ID_ERROR_DETAIL_LAST; other CAN messages have separate ID ranges and reassembly rules.
en.change: The baseline does not mark this ID/protocol definition as changed.

zh.plain: 触觉摘要使用 0x240–0x246 七帧，每帧七个 payload 字节，包含 summary、valid mask 和 CRC 输入。
zh.condition: 源码常量/表达式：`0x240`。它定义该消息类别的 ID 值或区间。
zh.effect: P4 按 seq 重组，要求 80 ms 内收齐并通过完整性校验。
zh.failure: 缺片、超时或 CRC 错会阻止本轮触觉快照发布。
zh.recovery: 这是 compact summary，不是完整 taxel raw dump。
zh.unknown: 源码是静态协议定义，不能证明当前总线帧已到达、数据新鲜或传感器物理读数正确。
zh.difference: 此节点说明 CAN_ID_TAC_SUMMARY_BASE 的编码/范围角色；其它 CAN 消息使用各自的 ID 区间和组包条件。
zh.change: 基线未标记该 ID/协议定义为本次变更。

en.plain: Tactile summary uses seven frames, 0x240–0x246, with seven payload bytes each for summary, valid mask, and CRC input.
en.condition: Source constant/expression: `0x240`. It defines the ID or range for this message class.
en.effect: P4 reassembles by sequence and requires complete reception within 80 ms plus integrity validation.
en.failure: Missing fragments, timeout, or CRC errors prevent publication of this tactile snapshot.
en.recovery: This is a compact summary, not the full taxel raw dump.
en.unknown: These are static protocol definitions; they do not prove a live frame arrived, data is fresh, or a physical sensor reading is correct.
en.difference: This node describes the encoding/range role of CAN_ID_TAC_SUMMARY_BASE; other CAN messages have separate ID ranges and reassembly rules.
en.change: The baseline does not mark this ID/protocol definition as changed.

zh.plain: 0x246 是触觉摘要七帧 ID 区间的末帧。
zh.condition: 源码常量/表达式：`0x246`。它定义该消息类别的 ID 值或区间。
zh.effect: 接收端需要 base 至 last 的全部分片与一致 sequence 才能发布 summary。
zh.failure: 末帧缺失或超出组包期限时，该轮摘要不完整。
zh.recovery: 勿将末帧单独解释成一份完整触觉数据。
zh.unknown: 源码是静态协议定义，不能证明当前总线帧已到达、数据新鲜或传感器物理读数正确。
zh.difference: 此节点说明 CAN_ID_TAC_SUMMARY_LAST 的编码/范围角色；其它 CAN 消息使用各自的 ID 区间和组包条件。
zh.change: 基线未标记该 ID/协议定义为本次变更。

en.plain: 0x246 is the last frame in the seven-ID tactile-summary range.
en.condition: Source constant/expression: `0x246`. It defines the ID or range for this message class.
en.effect: The receiver needs every fragment from base through last with a matching sequence before publishing the summary.
en.failure: If the last frame is missing or late, this summary is incomplete.
en.recovery: Do not interpret the last frame alone as a complete tactile sample.
en.unknown: These are static protocol definitions; they do not prove a live frame arrived, data is fresh, or a physical sensor reading is correct.
en.difference: This node describes the encoding/range role of CAN_ID_TAC_SUMMARY_LAST; other CAN messages have separate ID ranges and reassembly rules.
en.change: The baseline does not mark this ID/protocol definition as changed.

zh.plain: 0x3F0 专用于触觉 raw diagnostics，独立于 summary 和 full dump。
zh.condition: 源码常量/表达式：`0x3F0`。它定义该消息类别的 ID 值或区间。
zh.effect: P4 按 diagnostic 类型解析该 ID，不将其并入触觉载荷分片。
zh.failure: 版本或 DLC 不匹配时诊断字段无法可靠解读。
zh.recovery: 核对诊断版本号及收发两端 packet type。
zh.unknown: 源码是静态协议定义，不能证明当前总线帧已到达、数据新鲜或传感器物理读数正确。
zh.difference: 此节点说明 CAN_ID_TAC_RAW_DIAG 的编码/范围角色；其它 CAN 消息使用各自的 ID 区间和组包条件。
zh.change: 基线未标记该 ID/协议定义为本次变更。

en.plain: 0x3F0 is reserved for tactile raw diagnostics, separate from summary and full dump.
en.condition: Source constant/expression: `0x3F0`. It defines the ID or range for this message class.
en.effect: P4 parses this ID as a diagnostic type and does not add it to tactile payload fragments.
en.failure: A version or DLC mismatch makes diagnostic fields unreliable.
en.recovery: Check the diagnostic version and packet type on both ends.
en.unknown: These are static protocol definitions; they do not prove a live frame arrived, data is fresh, or a physical sensor reading is correct.
en.difference: This node describes the encoding/range role of CAN_ID_TAC_RAW_DIAG; other CAN messages have separate ID ranges and reassembly rules.
en.change: The baseline does not mark this ID/protocol definition as changed.

zh.plain: 全量触觉数据从 0x400 开始，按每帧七字节分片；需要帧数取决于 TACTILE_FULL_BYTES。
zh.condition: 源码常量/表达式：`0x400`。它定义该消息类别的 ID 值或区间。
zh.effect: P4 以序号和 frame mask 重组大数据包，CAN full dump 还受独立配置开关控制。
zh.failure: 缺帧/超时会令 dump 不完整；启用该流会提高 CAN 总线负载。
zh.recovery: 仅在需要原始全量触觉数据时开启，并观察带宽。
zh.unknown: 源码是静态协议定义，不能证明当前总线帧已到达、数据新鲜或传感器物理读数正确。
zh.difference: 此节点说明 CAN_ID_TAC_FULL_DUMP_BASE 的编码/范围角色；其它 CAN 消息使用各自的 ID 区间和组包条件。
zh.change: 基线未标记该 ID/协议定义为本次变更。

en.plain: Full tactile data starts at 0x400 and is fragmented at seven bytes per frame; count depends on TACTILE_FULL_BYTES.
en.condition: Source constant/expression: `0x400`. It defines the ID or range for this message class.
en.effect: P4 reassembles the large packet by sequence and frame mask; CAN full dump also has a separate configuration switch.
en.failure: Missing frames/timeouts make the dump incomplete; enabling this stream increases CAN bus load.
en.recovery: Enable only when full tactile data is needed and monitor bus load.
en.unknown: These are static protocol definitions; they do not prove a live frame arrived, data is fresh, or a physical sensor reading is correct.
en.difference: This node describes the encoding/range role of CAN_ID_TAC_FULL_DUMP_BASE; other CAN messages have separate ID ranges and reassembly rules.
en.change: The baseline does not mark this ID/protocol definition as changed.

zh.plain: full dump 末 ID 按 base 加帧数减一派生，帧数由 payload 字节数计算。
zh.condition: 源码常量/表达式：`CAN_ID_TAC_FULL_DUMP_BASE + CAN_TAC_FULL_FRAME_COUNT - 1`。它定义该消息类别的 ID 值或区间。
zh.effect: 两端必须按相同 payload 长度和每帧七字节规则计算末片位置。
zh.failure: 派生结果不一致会造成漏认末片或整批重组失败。
zh.recovery: 修改 payload 后核对 frame mask 位数和 receiver range。
zh.unknown: 源码是静态协议定义，不能证明当前总线帧已到达、数据新鲜或传感器物理读数正确。
zh.difference: 此节点说明 CAN_ID_TAC_FULL_DUMP_LAST 的编码/范围角色；其它 CAN 消息使用各自的 ID 区间和组包条件。
zh.change: 基线未标记该 ID/协议定义为本次变更。

en.plain: The full-dump endpoint is derived as base plus frame count minus one; count comes from payload bytes.
en.condition: Source constant/expression: `CAN_ID_TAC_FULL_DUMP_BASE + CAN_TAC_FULL_FRAME_COUNT - 1`. It defines the ID or range for this message class.
en.effect: Both ends must derive the endpoint from the same payload size and seven-byte-per-frame rule.
en.failure: A mismatch can misidentify the final fragment or prevent full reassembly.
en.recovery: After payload changes, verify frame-mask width and receiver range.
en.unknown: These are static protocol definitions; they do not prove a live frame arrived, data is fresh, or a physical sensor reading is correct.
en.difference: This node describes the encoding/range role of CAN_ID_TAC_FULL_DUMP_LAST; other CAN messages have separate ID ranges and reassembly rules.
en.change: The baseline does not mark this ID/protocol definition as changed.
